items.headline: Auburn's Alex Golesh discusses balancing gameplan, previews Arkansas
items.description: Golesh harps on the Tigers unraveling at the end of Auburn's loss to Ole Miss and explains how they want to get the running backs involved more ahead of their matchup against the Razorbacks.

items.headline: Ryan Silverfield says Arkansas must protect the ball vs. Auburn
items.description: Silverfield emphasizes that the Razorbacks must improve when it comes to protecting the football and preventing turnovers if they hope to have success against the Tigers.

items.headline: Auburn hosts Arkansas in SEC play
items.description: Arkansas (3-5) at Auburn (4-4), Nov. 7 at 12:45 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Austin Simmons leads No. 23 Missouri to 34-10 win over Arkansas
items.description: — Austin Simmons threw for 179 yards and two touchdowns, and Jamal Roberts had 158 total yards and two touchdowns as No. 23 Missouri topped Arkansas 34-10 on Saturday night.
